title: Smiling Child Reading Book in Bed, 1950s B&W Bedroom Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century square snapshot with deckled edges featuring a smiling young African American child tucked cozily in bed under a textured white blanket. The child is propped up against a white pillow in front of a dark wooden headboard fitted with a mounted reading light, holding an open book and looking directly at the camera. The setting conveys warmth, comfort, and peaceful domestic life during the 1950s.
